usedFor: SuperSaaS holds the appointments, and Gtwy receives a chat request for an AI agent through “Call AI Agent Instantly”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy
bestTemplate.why: A new appointment has details worth passing on, and the action sends them in a chat request.

watchOut: “Appointment Changes” fires on created, changed and deleted appointments, so use “New Appointment” for new ones only.
